newsitem.title: USA: Trans Energy ready to drill Wyo prospect.
newsitem.headline: Trans Energy ready to drill Wyo prospect.

text.p: Trans Energy Inc said it will drill the first well on a Crook County, Wyo., prospect is called "Prima" in the fourth quarter.
Trans Energy said the presence of the Minnelusa "B" Sand is confirmed by the 3-D Seismic.
The well will be a test of the Minnelusa Upper "B" Sand at a depth of 5,900 feet. It is expected that there will be 10 well locations on the 800 acre prospect.

The prospect is one mile south of the Jewel field which has produced 800,000 barrels from one 40 acre tract, one mile east of the Little Missouri field which has produced 1.7 million barrels since 1986, and 1.5 miles northeast of the Lad field which has produced 3.2 million barrels.
